description: Cases for the tel: link in the URL field. 'works': decided behaviour, the complete list of links expected for the input (in text order; a link target is the lower case scheme plus the number). 'fails': decided behaviour, no tel: link is expected. 'observed': behaviour seen in a test and not decided yet; 'links' is what the code gives today, a decision may change it. 'field' defaults to 'url'; the other values are 'notes', 'custom', 'username', 'password', 'title' and 'unset' (no tag). 'generated' builds a long input from a repeated unit. 'decision' names the decision a case verifies or waits for. Every 'works' and 'observed' input is also run in all other fields and must give no tel: link there. RFC means RFC 3966.
